mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing quetiapine plasma concentrations, while both agents possess CNS effects and ginkgo has mild antiplatelet properties.
action: Monitor for increased quetiapine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, QT prolongation); consider quetiapine dose adjustment if ginkgo is initiated; counsel on bleeding risk with concurrent use.
